# lumen/src/ui/settings.rs

Settings view: sidebar pages.

- Pages: General, Appearance, Search, Files, Clipboard, About.
- `ACCENTS` color list.
- Helpers: `group`, `field`, `switch`, `dropdown`, `path_list` (file roots / excludes).
- `change(f)` → `App::update_settings`.
- `step_page` — Up/Down, Ctrl+Tab page nav.
